mood.description: Initially neutral, transitioning to sad due to Puppey's disappointment.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Puppey's slightly forced smile when he describes the TI as 'up and down' hints at underlying disappointment, shifting the mood slightly towards sad.
Puppey's facial expression and tone become more noticeably disappointed.
Puppey explicitly expresses sadness with the words 'This is so sad.'

narrativeProgression.description: Interviewer sets context, mentions Team Secret's top 6 finish.
Puppey acknowledges tournament has been 'up and down'.
Puppey talks about good draft and strong advantage in the first game.
Puppey emphasizes they should have won the first game.
Puppey expresses sadness about leaving the tournament.
